About Fashion Factory

Fashion Made Easy to Discover.

Fashion Factory is a fashion and clothing retail destination in Sorakhutte, Kathmandu, where you can browse current styles, see pieces up close, and try them on in person.

No app, no guesswork — just walk in, or message us first if you'd like to check what's in before you come.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked

Where is Fashion Factory located?

Fashion Factory is in the Sorakhutte area of Kathmandu, Nepal. Use the "Open in Google Maps" button above for exact directions.

What are the store opening hours?

We're open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Can I contact the store before visiting?

Yes — call or message us on WhatsApp at +977 9840260456 any time before you come by.

Can I ask about product availability?

Contact us on WhatsApp or by phone to ask about a specific item.

Where can I see your latest products?

Follow @fashion.factory_2022 on Instagram for the newest styles and updates.
